headline: Why Isn't My Garage Conversion Getting Approved?
articleBody: It's super frustrating when your garage-to-ADU project hits a snag with city approvals, right? Often, the hold-up comes from not fully understanding California's ever-evolving ADU regulations or the specific requirements of your local building department in places like Cerritos or Irvine. A big mistake folks make is jumping into design without a solid grasp of zoning laws, setback rules, and parking requirements. You might think a simple garage conversion is straightforward, but it involves structural, electrical, and plumbing changes that need to meet strict codes. Forgetting accessibility standards or fire separation requirements can also throw a wrench in the works. Plus, if your plans don't clearly communicate compliance, inspectors can and will send them back. Having an experienced general contractor who knows the ins and outs of local permitting, like Affordable Home Remodeling in Southern California, can save you a ton of headaches and rework. We've got that long-term field background and local knowledge to help navigate the complexities, ensuring your plans are solid from the get-go. If you're struggling with permits, it's probably time to bring in the pros.
